Package com.google.adk.workflow

Class EdgesBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.google.adk.workflow.EdgesBuilder
@Experimental public final class EdgesBuilder extends Object
A builder for the edges of a workflow graph, declared as chains of calls that start at from(com.google.adk.workflow.Node) or fromStart(). Create one with new EdgesBuilder() and call build(), or let Workflow.Builder.edges(Consumer) do both. A node is identified by its instance, so create each node once. 

 Workflow support =
     Workflow.builder()
         .name("support_triage")
         .edges(
             g -> {
               g.fromStart()
                   .chain(classify, category)
                   .route(
                       r -> {
                         r.on("billing").then(billing);
                         r.otherwise(summarize);
                       });
               g.from(billing).then(summarize);
             })
         .build();

    Description

    EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain
    A chain of edges positioned at a node, started by from(Node), fromStart() or EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain.joinTo(com.google.adk.workflow.JoinNode).
    static final class 
    EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain
    A chain of edges positioned at a node group from a fan-out, from(Node, Node, Node...), or from(Collection), which EdgesBuilder.NodeGroupChain.joinTo(com.google.adk.workflow.JoinNode) connects to a JoinNode.
    static final class 
    EdgesBuilder.RouteMap
    A routing map configured in EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain.route(java.util.function.Consumer<? super com.google.adk.workflow.EdgesBuilder.RouteMap>) that maps each route the source node may emit to the nodes it leads to, written r.on("billing").then(billing).
    static final class 
    EdgesBuilder.RouteMapEntry
    A routing-map entry started by EdgesBuilder.RouteMap.on(java.lang.String) whose routes have no target yet; EdgesBuilder.RouteMapEntry.then(com.google.adk.workflow.Node, com.google.adk.workflow.Node...) completes it.
    static final class 
    EdgesBuilder.RouteSet
    A set of routes that select a single edge, which fires once when its source emits any of them; separate edges to the same target would fire once each.
